intro: One murtabak ayam (4 slices) is roughly 700 kcal. Most of the calories come from the roti dough fried in oil, followed by the egg and chicken filling.

variants.name: Murtabak ayam with full curry gravy

diet: Yes, especially if you share. Murtabak actually has decent protein from the chicken and eggs. The issue is the oil and the big portion. Have 2 slices with pickled onions or salad, and you can still stay within your calorie budget.
tips: Order one murtabak for two people, 2 slices each.
Ask for kuah dal on the side and just dip, don't flood it.
Drink teh O kosong or warm water, not teh tarik, so you don't add extra calories.

swap.name: Roti telur with kuah dal
swap.why: You still get filling roti and egg, but a smaller portion with less oil.

faq.q: What's the difference between mamak murtabak and Arab murtabak?
faq.a: Mamak murtabak usually has a minced meat filling with egg and onion, eaten with curry. The Middle Eastern style is thicker, and the filling depends on the country.

faq.q: Can I keep murtabak to eat the next day?
faq.a: Yes. Keep it in the fridge and eat within 1-2 days. Reheat in an air fryer or a dry pan without oil so it gets crispy again.

faq.q: Why is murtabak eaten with pickled onions?
faq.a: The sour, fresh pickled onions balance out the oiliness of the murtabak. They also add flavour without many calories.
